content:
Apple TV+ has a brand new original film launching today: action comedy "Mayday," starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh.

"Mayday" is available to stream for free with an Apple TV subscription. The story is set during the Cold War, where Troy (Reynolds) infiltrates Russia on a mission, and former KGB agent Nikolai (Branagh) unexpectedly becomes his ally as they embark on this battle of wits.

Troy expects to be captured and killed, but Nikolai harbours a fondness for American culture and helps him leave Russia. "Mayday" subverts the usual tropes of Cold War thrillers and makes liberal use of classic references to 1980s films such as "Top Gun".

If you're looking for a light-hearted action comedy to ease you through a Friday night, "Mayday" might just hit the spot — especially if you're a fan of Ryan Reynolds' brand of humour. The film has also received a decent critical response, currently holding an 84% fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes from critics.

"Mayday" is now streaming on Apple TV, and viewers can watch it via the Apple TV app on iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Mac, Android, Windows, Roku, Amazon Fire Stick, Xbox, PlayStation and other platforms, or head to tv.apple.com via a web browser.

"Mayday" is Apple's latest original film, and the Apple TV platform now boasts a catalogue of more than 330 original series and film titles.

Coming later this month are new series "Last Seen," the sixth season of "Slow Horses," and new comedy "Brothers." Other noteworthy upcoming titles include "Matchbox" and "Tenzing," both set for release in October.
